mechanical.mechanism: Opposed hooked masts: central lifting cord plus three perimeter tension stays
mechanical.requiredThread: 4 lengths of0.4–0.8 mm nonstretch cord;150 mm center plus3×250 mm stays, knot allowance included. Not exported.
mechanical.retention: Calibrated friction at mast feet, optional glue. Knot adjustment/tension retains upper assembly; not a rigid shelf.

collisions.staticModel: Ideal vertical flexible cords; choose outer prestress total3× upper weight to exhibit positive moment-balanced tensions. Illustrative feasibility, not a recommended physical tension or tested stability.
collisions.assemblySequence: Insert lower mast from above; upper mast from below. Support plates at separation; tie central lifting cord, then three perimeter stays. Level and remove temporary support. Optional glue at mast feet.
